_comment: voiceChannelId = where Coo speaks. textChannelIds empty = ONLY the voice channel's own chat box (the panel on the right in KOOK). Fill ids to also listen to other text channels. textReplyMode: verbatim (read the message aloud) or brain (let Coo answer it).

ear._comment: replyMode: name = only answer when called by alias, always = answer everything, off = just print. device = KOOK's OUTPUT device (loopback). monitor = ALSO play her voice on this PC - only for debugging when KOOK's own playback is unavailable; leaving it on causes double playback / echo.
ear._device_note: 留空 = 采集所有环回并混音（哪路在出声就采哪路，中途换 KOOK 输出设备不用改配置）。填设备名子串则只采那一路，例如 'MCHOSE'。
ear._mic_note: 留空 = 用 Windows 默认麦克风（KOOK 里也选 Default 就永远对得上）。填名字子串则只采那一个，例如 'MCHOSE'。

brain._comment: apigoto 中转站，可用模型只有 deepseek-flash。它默认会先输出 reasoning_content，把 max_tokens 烧光后 content 就是空的（表现为「等很久然后没声」），所以 disableThinking 必须开。实测关掉后 reasoning=0、首字约 0.7s。
